Hi all, this week’s changelog is quick and simple, nothing user-visible to announce.


We’ve been making R&D progress towards better[template-aware-caching](https://blog.butter.dev/template-aware-caching) , and infra progress rethinking the storage system to work with higher availability.


We’ve also published a[Terms of Service](https://github.com/butter-dot-dev/legal/blob/main/TOS.md) and[Privacy Policy](https://github.com/butter-dot-dev/legal/blob/main/PrivacyPolicy.md) .


Stay tuned next week for more updates!
